title: 4D Chicago Source
description: One bibliographic source, one file. The filename stem is the source_id.

date.description: Publication or creation date as written on the source.

describes_date.description: The date the source DESCRIBES, when different from when it was made. Wau-Bun was published 1856 and describes 1831; that gap is the whole reason this field exists.

archived_url.description: Required for type=website and for any online-only source. A citation that cannot be re-read is not a citation.

locator.description: Page, plate, scan page, or IIIF region. Cite the specific place, not the whole volume.

tier.description: 1 period/eyewitness · 2 near-primary recollection · 3 compiled secondary (Andreas) · 4 later scholarship · 5 modern retrospective illustration/reconstruction · 6 decorative/popular cartography. Tiers 5-6 inform inventory and cross-checks only; never sole evidence for documented, never traced for geometry.

rights_status.description: check_required and restricted block asset derivation; textual citation stays allowed.

rights_checked.description: Fill when moving check_required to cleared or restricted.

asset_use.description: How far this source may be used. 'geometry' permits tracing; 'orientation' permits toponyms and rough placement only.

verified.description: True only when a human or agent has actually retrieved and read this source at its locator.

access_notes.description: Fetch problems worth recording, e.g. hosts that return 503/403 to automated retrieval.
